lessons.claim: The RUN.builder contract's pe_per_particle() asks for 'a scalar that is both the equilibrium indicator and the frozen watchdog', and an active system with neither pair interactions nor a trap (abp-rod) has no potential energy. Instead the orientational correlation against the previous call, ⟨cos(θ_now-θ_prev)⟩, was used -- when normal, every call is a different noise realization so it is never exactly constant (no false FROZEN), and if the rotational diffusion dies it locks to exactly 1.0 (a real FROZEN detection). A pattern reusable when moving a system with no PE/N onto RUN.builder.
